title: Summarize long documents with Claude

body.text: Claude reads and summarizes long documents very well, because it has a
context window of up to 200,000 tokens
— just upload a PDF report or a contract, then ask which parts you want summarized.

example: "Summarize this annual report, focusing on the key numbers, the main strategy, and the risks worth watching"

title: Writing reports and memos

body.text: audience, the tone, and the key points that must be included
— Claude will then write something that fits your needs, instead of something generic.

example: "Write a one-page executive memo for the CEO about Q3 results, formal tone, focused on action items"

question: Why is Claude well-suited to summarizing long documents?

options.text: Claude reads faster than a person
Claude has a large context window of up to 200K tokens, so it can read a long document whole

question: What should you tell Claude before asking it to write a report?

options.text: The audience, the tone, and the key points the report must include
The filename you want to save it as

question: How do you upload a PDF for Claude to analyze?

options.text: Use the attachment clip in Claude.ai and upload the file directly
Copy all the text and paste it into the chat

question: You have a long report and want a short memo summary — what should you do?

options.text: Paste the document and ask for a memo summary organized by topic

question: What does summarizing documents with Claude help with?

options.text: Saves time and quickly pulls out the main points
